question.question_text: As of 2023-01-01, will the monthly 3-month yield change for United States 3-month Treasury yield in 2023-01 be at least 0.26 percentage points?
question.context:
Entity: United States 3-month Treasury yield
Target period: 2023-01
Financial area: monetary_policy / short-term rates
Region: US
question.resolution_criteria: Use FRED series DGS3MO. Compute the change from the previous monthly observation using mode 'absolute'. Resolve yes if the change is at least 0.26 percentage points, otherwise no.
question.resolution_reasoning: The snapshotted target change was 0.28 percentage points; it resolved to 'yes'.

finance.comparison_rule: target change >= median of 4 prior observed changes

resolution_document.title: 3-Month Treasury Constant Maturity Rate
